# Alemar Capoeira Chișinău

> Brazilian martial art school in Chișinău, Moldova. Active since 2003.

Alemar Capoeira Chișinău is the only dedicated capoeira school in Moldova, operating continuously since 2003. Capoeira is a Brazilian martial art combining combat techniques, acrobatics, and live music. The school teaches all styles and accepts students of all ages and levels.

- Schedule: Monday, Wednesday, Friday — 18:30 to 20:30
- First class is free
- Open to all ages and levels

## About Capoeira

Capoeira originated among enslaved Africans in Brazil. It blends martial arts, acrobatics, dance, and music. Participants play inside a roda (circle) accompanied by the berimbau, atabaque, and pandeiro. The school practices both Capoeira Angola and Capoeira Regional styles.

## Pages for each audience

- Capoeira for kids (from age 5, non-aggressive, kids and parents train in one group): https://capoeira.md/en/kids
- Capoeira for adults (mobility, strength, beginners welcome): https://capoeira.md/en/adults
- Brazilian culture (instruments, songs in Portuguese, roda, batizado): https://capoeira.md/en/culture
- Romanian and Russian versions: replace /en/ with /ro/ or /ru/

## Song Collection

The site includes a digital capoeira songbook with 25 traditional songs used in training and ceremonies, including ladainhas, corridos, and quadras.
